status: ROUND 3. Registered after rounds 1 and 2 were seen and BEFORE this candidate was run. criteria.json S1-S7 apply verbatim at both frame rates. Rounds 1 and 2 are preserved (experiment-round1/2.json, verdict-round1/2.json).
honest_labelling: Third design on the same footage, each shaped by the previous round's failures (round 2's post-hoc classification: of 4,258 leaked injected phantom boxes, 3,392 rode a proven track that the static box had captured, and only 1,737 of those were in frames with a real ball in view). A pass shows consistency with the registered criteria after adaptive design, not blind generalization; no untouched footage exists. Three rounds is the limit: if this fails, the experiment ends and the failure is reported.

H2_current_proof.idea: H, but proof of motion must be CURRENT. A proven track loses its proof when, over the last `revoke_window_ref_frames`, its boxes have spread less than `revoke_range_px`; its proof is then re-earned by moving `proof_distance_px` from where it was revoked. A static box that captures a ball's track is therefore un-proven after one revoke window instead of living on.
H2_current_proof.why: all H parameters unchanged. 20 reference frames (0.67 s) is just over twice the longest genuine still stretch on development clips (7 frames, within 3 px) and above the 15-frame stall S5 requires to survive; 10 px is a ball's jitter plus its slowest rolling over 20 frames, well under one ball width (24 px).

sensitivity_only_not_eligible.purpose: how dependent the result is on the one new parameter; not eligible, and r15 is not allowed to be chosen over r20 whatever it scores

decision_rule: as criteria.json. Pass at both frame rates or nothing is recommended.
